parameters.name: gridx
parameters.description: number of bases along x-axis

parameters.name: gridy
parameters.description: number of bases along y-axis

parameters.name: gridz
parameters.description: bin height. See bin height information and "gridz_define" below.

parameters.name: half_grid
parameters.description: Half grid sized bins.  Implies "only corners".

parameters.name: gridz_define
parameters.description: How "gridz" is used to calculate height.  Some exclude 7mm/1U base, others exclude ~3.5mm (4.4mm nominal) stacking lip.

options.label: Internal mm - Excludes Base & Stacking Lip

parameters.name: height_internal
parameters.description: Overrides internal block height of bin (for solid containers). Leave zero for default height. Units: mm

parameters.name: enable_zsnap
parameters.description: snap gridz height to nearest 7mm increment

parameters.name: divx
parameters.description: number of X Divisions (set to zero to have solid bin)

parameters.name: divy
parameters.description: number of Y Divisions (set to zero to have solid bin)

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Leave zero for default. Units: mm

parameters.name: cut_cylinders
parameters.description: Use this instead of bins

parameters.name: cd
parameters.description: diameter of cylindrical cut outs

parameters.name: c_chamfer
parameters.description: chamfer around the top rim of the holes

parameters.name: style_tab
parameters.description: the type of tabs

parameters.name: place_tab
parameters.description: which divisions have tabs

parameters.name: scoop
parameters.description: scoop weight percentage. 0 disables scoop, 1 is regular scoop. Any real number will scale the scoop.

parameters.name: only_corners
parameters.description: only cut magnet/screw holes at the corners of the bin to save uneccesary print time

parameters.name: refined_holes
parameters.description: Use gridfinity refined hole style. Not compatible with magnet_holes!

parameters.name: magnet_holes
parameters.description: Base will have holes for 6mm Diameter x 2mm high magnets.

parameters.name: screw_holes
parameters.description: Base will have holes for M3 screws.

parameters.name: crush_ribs
parameters.description: Magnet holes will have crush ribs to hold the magnet.

parameters.name: chamfer_holes
parameters.description: Magnet/Screw holes will have a chamfer to ease insertion.

parameters.name: printable_hole_top
parameters.description: Magnet/Screw holes will be printed so supports are not needed.

parameters.name: enable_thumbscrew
parameters.description: Enable "gridfinity-refined" thumbscrew hole in the center of each base: https://www.printables.com/model/413761-gridfinity-refined

computed_skipped.name: hole_options
computed_skipped.expression: bundle_hole_options(refined_holes, magnet_holes, screw_holes, crush_ribs, chamfer_holes, printable_hole_top)
